categories.title: Item Box
categories.info: Items placed into Item Boxes can be retrieved from any other Item Box. Magic!

categories.title: Typewriter
categories.info: Typewriters are used to save the game. On Hardcore difficulty, you'll need Ink Ribbons to use them.

categories.title: Film
categories.info: Bring rolls of film to the Darkroom Sink to process them.

categories.title: Hip Pouch
categories.info: Hip Pouches expand your inventory by 2 slots.

categories.title: Grenade Rounds
categories.info: Used by the GM 79, a weapon exclusive to Claire.

categories.title: Hand Grenade
categories.info: Used to escape grabs and / or deliver a lethal blast.

categories.title: High-Powered Rounds
categories.info: A powerful alternate ammo for the SLS 60, a weapon exclusive to Claire.

categories.title: Needle Cartridges
categories.info: Ammunition for the Spark Shot, a weapon exclusive to Claire.

categories.title: SMG Ammo
categories.info: Used by the MQ 11, a weapon exclusive to Claire.

categories.title: Blue Herb
categories.info: Blue Herbs are used to cure poison. They can be combined with Green Herbs to provide some healing, too.

categories.title: First Aid Spray
categories.info: First Aid Spray completely restores your Health.

categories.title: Green Herb
categories.info: Green Herbs can be consumed as-is to restore a little health, or combined with Red and / or Blue herbs for additional effects.

categories.title: Red Herb
categories.info: Red Herbs cannot be consumed as-is. Combine them with Green Herbs to create a strong medicine.

categories.title: Window
categories.info: Can be boarded up with wooden planks to prevent zombies getting through.
